pageHero.title: Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
pageHero.subtitle: Clinical training and academic engagement in child and adolescent psychiatry, with experience spanning residency rotations, supervised clinical exposure, scientific poster presentations, congress participation, continuous medical education, and psychoeducational initiatives.

overview.title: A developing clinical profile grounded in child mental health, trauma, neurodevelopment, and family-centered care.
overview.body: Mohamed’s psychiatry pillar combines supervised residency experience, scientific dissemination, congress participation, and continuing medical education. The page is intentionally sober and academic, designed for hospital panels, psychiatry boards, university committees, and clinical collaborators.
highlights: Resident in child and adolescent psychiatry across university hospital settings
Scientific posters and accepted abstracts on ADHD, ASD, trauma exposure, child violence, parenting, and school identification
Continuing medical education in neurodevelopment, psychiatric emergencies, psychoeducation, bullying prevention, gaming addiction, and child protection-related topics

clinicalPathway.sectionIntro: A chronological view of supervised clinical exposure and medical rotations.

entries.institution: Child & Adolescent Psychiatry Department, Fattouma Bourguiba University Hospital
entries.description: Participates in multidisciplinary follow-up, patient assessment, case discussions, and exposure to diagnostic and therapeutic approaches in child and adolescent psychiatry.
details: Applied exposure to adolescent psychiatry and clinically sensitive situations requiring coordination with external authorities.
Postvention work in school environments following suicide attempts to identify vulnerable young people and assess mental health needs.
Rapid response to pediatric psychiatric emergencies including suicidal crises, extreme agitation, and acute delusional presentations.
Child protection-related assessment in cases involving violence, maltreatment, or police requisition, with medical and protection-oriented recommendations.
Therapeutic care for adolescents using approaches adapted to adolescent clinical needs.

entries.institution: Child & Adolescent Psychiatry Department, Razi University Hospital
entries.description: Completed supervised clinical exposure across consultation and multidisciplinary care settings, strengthening understanding of mental health service delivery for children and adolescents.
details: Observed outpatient and inpatient care processes, consultation dynamics, case discussion, and coordination of care.
Gained exposure to psychoeducational assessment tools and profiles, psychiatric on-call duties, hospitalization, outpatient consultations, and academic seminar coordination.

entries.institution: Child & Adolescent Psychiatry Department, Military Hospital
entries.description: Engaged in practical training related to child mental health assessment, psychosocial support, and psychiatric care pathways in a hospital setting.
details: Participated in clinical learning activities and case discussions involving neurodevelopmental, behavioral, emotional, and trauma-related presentations.
Contributed to observation of emergency and on-call exposure, including somatic and psychiatric on-call contexts.

entries.description: Completed emergency medical exposure within SAMU and emergency care contexts.

entries.institution: Infectious Diseases Department, Rabta University Hospital
entries.description: Completed medical internship exposure in infectious diseases.

entries.institution: Orthopedic Surgery and Traumatology Emergency Care Department, CTGB
entries.description: Completed internship exposure in orthopedic surgery, traumatology, and emergency care.

entries.institution: Gynecology B Department, Wassila University Hospital
entries.description: Completed medical internship exposure in gynecology.
